projectDescription: A hands-free diagram editor powered by webcam hand tracking and browser-local voice commands, built on maxGraph for full-featured diagramming without touching the keyboard or mouse.
keyFeatures: Index-fingertip camera pointer via MediaPipe Hand Landmarker
Browser-local offline voice commands via Vosk WebAssembly
Air Pen drawing with adaptive thumb calibration and automatic shape recognition
Real maxGraph editor with selection, resize, drag, connectors, undo, and text labels
Gesture zoom with orientation-independent pinch measurement
Voice-controlled shape creation, multi-select, clipboard, and deletion
Optional Wispr Flow integration for free-form shape renaming on macOS
Personal pinch trainer with local-storage persistence
publicApiSurface: GestureSettings (sensitivity, smoothing, pinchThreshold, doublePinchMs, confidenceThreshold, mirrorX, showPreview, showDebug, voiceCommands, pinchActions)

VoiceCommand types: click, hold, release, selectShape, selectAnchor, rename, finishRename, startArrow, finishArrow, startLine, startZoom, endZoom, startDraw, endDraw, tool, addShape, undo, redo, delete, copy, cut, paste, cancel
